title: Product Names Were Norwegian-Only — Now Ukrainian Too | vitalii.no
description:
A Ukrainian-speaking parent using the app to log her child's meals had to recognize every product by its Norwegian name — searching in her own language, like typing овсянка for oatmeal, returned nothing at all. Products extracted automatically from photos came back Norwegian-only too, with no way to add a Ukrainian name without editing each entry by hand.

A migration added a translation column to the products table, storing a name and portion size per language. The product library, picker, viewer and the food row inside the dose calculator were all updated to read and show that translation under the Norwegian name. Search now checks both languages, editors can correct a translation directly, and new products scanned in by the AI pipeline arrive with the Ukrainian line already filled in.

The change is about reach, not speed: every product added since now carries a Ukrainian name and portion size automatically, and a search for овсянка returns the exact same entry as havregrøt.
